card.name: "On" before the tongue in ODT directions
card.fires_on: The word "on", "onto" or the following "the" right after place, put or administer, where the next word is expected to be tongue. Seen in directions for orally disintegrating tablets and oral granules.

modes.label: Placing tablet on tongue
modes.description: "on" right after "placed" or "place the ODT" in orally disintegrating tablet directions.
modes.example: the orally disintegrating tablet placed<< on>> the tongue, where tablets may be swallowed

modes.label: Granules onto tongue
modes.description: "onto" or the following "the" when granules are given straight onto the tongue or sprinkled on food.

card.plain: It marks the spot in dosing directions where a tablet is placed on the tongue.
